description: The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and has a linear scale ranging from -1 to 21, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “Sparsity Ratio” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.8, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2.  A dashed blue line, labeled “sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.003”, begins at approximately 0.4 when Layer is -1, and decreases to approximately 0.02 when Layer is 21, remaining relatively stable throughout. An orange dotted line, labeled “sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.126”, starts at approximately 0.7 when Layer is -1, and declines to approximately 0.1 when Layer is 21. A green dashed line, labeled “sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.080”, begins at approximately 0.5 when Layer is -1, and decreases to approximately 0.05 when Layer is 21, exhibiting a steeper decline than the orange line between Layers 0 and 5.
